title.zh: 手机片段：拒绝播放的原因被丢掉了，状态行说不清是哪一种
title.en: Phone clips: the refusal reason was discarded, so the line could not say which failure it was

highlights.zh: 播放器本来算出了原因（浏览器拒绝、还是这段片段取不到），外壳却把参数丢掉，所以只说「无法播放」。现在原因随状态行一起给出。
highlights.en: The player already worked out the reason — the browser refused, or the clip would not load — and the shell dropped the argument, so the line could only say that it failed. The reason now travels with it.

highlights.zh: 状态行的优先级抽成纯函数并加了判据：拒绝播放会让 isPlaying 变 false，写成 isPlaying ? 播放中 : 空闲 就会把「被拒」显示成「没点过」。
highlights.en: The status precedence became a pure function with a criterion: a refusal makes isPlaying false, so a naive `isPlaying ? playing : idle` reports "never started" for exactly the case the user needs to know about.

title.zh: 手机唱片：进度条走到底就不动了，切歌还会黑一下
title.en: Phone record: the bar stopped at the end, and a track change flashed empty

highlights.zh: 进度条读的是「从片段开始算了多少步」，却在第一步循环之后就被钳在 100%：chicago-house 16.6 秒、124 BPM，条在 1.94 秒就满了。现在按循环取余，它会一直转。
highlights.en: The bar read the step count since the clip began, then clamped at 100 % after the first loop: chicago-house is 16.6 s at 124 BPM, and the bar filled at 1.94 s. It is reduced modulo the loop now, so it keeps cycling.

highlights.zh: 切歌时封面会先清空再加载，唱片中间的图因此空白一段时间，看起来就是黑一下。现在旧封面留到新封面解码完成；解码过的封面按 URL 缓存。
highlights.en: Changing records cleared the cover before loading the next, so the artwork in the middle of the disc was blank for a moment — the flash. The previous cover now stays until the new one has decoded, and decoded covers are cached by URL.

title.zh: 手机片段：音频主机写错，159 条全指向解析不了的域名
title.en: Phone clips: all 159 audio addresses named a host that does not resolve

highlights.zh: 自 v2.37.6 起片段清单的主机写成 r2mirror.wangda.today（DNS 解析不了），正确是 r2mirror.groove.wangda.today，所以手机壳一首也放不出，只是安静。159 条已重指。
highlights.en: Since v2.37.6 the clip manifest named r2mirror.wangda.today, which does not resolve; the mirror is r2mirror.groove.wangda.today, so the phone shell could not play a single clip — the only symptom was silence. All 159 are re-pointed.

highlights.zh: 发版门禁新增片段清单检查：上传前比对每条片段的主机与所配置镜像，不一致就拒绝发布。
highlights.en: The deploy gate now checks the clip manifest too: before anything is uploaded, every clip's host is compared against the configured mirror and a mismatch refuses the release.

title.zh: 手机片段：拒绝播放要说出来，下一首先取好
title.en: Phone clips: a refusal is said out loud, and the next record is fetched early

highlights.zh: 浏览器拒绝 play() 或片段取不到时，界面原本一直显示「播放中」且无提示；现在状态行报「无法播放 —— 点播放重试」。
highlights.en: When the browser refused play() or the clip would not load, the shell kept showing "playing" with nothing on screen to say otherwise; the status line now reads "Could not play — tap play to retry".

highlights.zh: 切歌不再现拉：当前这首播放时预取队列的下一首，切歌成为缓存命中（repeat-one 不预取）。
highlights.en: Switching records no longer waits on the network: the queue's next clip is warmed while the current one plays, so an advance is a cache hit (repeat-one warms nothing).

title.zh: 排列视图：改一个音符不再重画整片缩略图
title.en: Arrangement: one note edit no longer redraws every miniature

highlights.zh: 修复轨道缩略图的 key 含数组下标导致的整片重挂：真实作品实测，一次编辑的迷你节点被替换数由 816 降到 0，新增变更由 817 降到 27。
highlights.en: Fixes an index-bearing React key on track miniatures that made one note edit remount them all: measured on a real piece, replaced miniature nodes fell from 816 to 0 and churn from 817 to 27.

highlights.zh: key 改用音符自身身份。typecheck 0 错、排列相关判据 37/37；该修复的自动化判据仍待补（已如实标注）。
highlights.en: The key now uses the note's own identity. Typecheck is clean and the arrangement criteria are 37/37; an automated criterion for this fix is still to be written, and is stated as such.

title.zh: 手机片段：可点击可键盘操作的进度条
title.en: Phone clips: a position rail you can seek with

highlights.zh: 手机片段播放器新增由真实音频驱动的进度条：点击或左右键 seek、两端自动 clamp、切片段与从零重播自动归零。
highlights.en: The phone clip player gains a rail driven by the element's own audio: press or arrow keys to seek, both ends clamp, and it returns to zero on a clip switch and on a restart from the top.

highlights.zh: 8 条判据覆盖映射、NaN/0 时长守卫、两端 clamp、点击 seek、键盘步进、切片段与重播归零。typecheck 0 错。
highlights.en: Eight criteria cover the mapping, the NaN/zero-duration guard, both clamps, press-to-seek, keyboard steps, and the resets on clip switch and restart. Typecheck is clean.

title.zh: 手机片段：修掉预取与播放抢同一条片段
title.en: Phone clips: stop the prefetch and the player racing for one clip

highlights.zh: 修复竞态：元素已在加载时不再预取；晚到的 blob 直接释放、绝不中途换 src。线上探针实测同一片段曾发出两次 /clips/ 请求（约 400 KB 的重复下载）。
highlights.en: Fixes the race: no prefetch once the element is already loading, and a late blob is released rather than swapped in mid-load. The live probe had measured two /clips/ requests for one clip — a ~400 KB repeat download.

highlights.zh: 类级判据 7 条（已在加载不发请求、竞态中 blob 被释放且 src 不变）。组件级顺序在 jsdom 未覆盖，已如实说明。
highlights.en: Seven class-level criteria, including that an already-loading element issues no fetch and a mid-load blob is released with src unchanged. The component-level ordering is not covered in jsdom and is stated as such.

title.zh: 手机片段：预取并缓存，重播不再重复下载
title.en: Phone clips: prefetch and cache, so a replay is not a second download

highlights.zh: 手机片段播放器改为空闲时用自己的 fetch 预取即将播放的那一条并按 URL 缓存；实测片段约 400 KB，R2 无 cache-control，重播不再重复下载。
highlights.en: The phone clip player now prefetches the clip about to play on its own fetch while idle and caches it by URL; clips are ~400 KB and the mirror sends no cache-control, so a replay no longer re-downloads.

highlights.zh: 新增单元判据：并发两次取同一 URL 只发一次请求，已缓存再播零请求。未取得真机耗电读数。
highlights.en: A unit criterion pins it: two concurrent loads of one URL fetch once, and a cached URL issues no further fetch. No on-device battery reading was taken.

title.zh: 可视化循环节流并在空闲停帧
title.en: Throttle the visualiser loops and stop them when idle

highlights.zh: 5 处可视化循环（VinylCanvas、两个示波器、PhosphorOscilloscope、ConsolePanel 电平表）在移动/触屏节流到约 40 FPS，Header 可视化空闲时彻底停帧。
highlights.en: Five visualiser loops (VinylCanvas, both scopes, PhosphorOscilloscope, the ConsolePanel meters) are throttled to about 40 FPS on mobile/touch, and the Header visualiser stops entirely when idle.

highlights.zh: 新增确定性判据：播放时每帧仍排队（节流而非冻死）、空闲时从不排队；把排队移到节流检查之后即变红。120Hz 帧率本机未测。
highlights.en: A deterministic gate now pins that the loop is re-armed every frame while playing (throttled, not dead) and never while idle; moving the re-arm after the throttle check turns it red. No 120 Hz frame rate was measured here.

title.zh: 把调度器每步分配实测并钉成门禁
title.en: Measure the scheduler's per-step allocations and pin them

highlights.zh: 音频调度器每步恰好分配 4 个对象（64 步 256 个），且不随轨道数增长；据此新增确定性门禁，每步多一次分配即红。
highlights.en: The audio scheduler allocates exactly 4 objects per step (256 over 64 steps) and that does not grow with track count; a deterministic gate now trips on one extra allocation per step.

highlights.zh: 结论是无需改产品代码：与 wasm 核心的零分配契约一致；此门禁只防回归，不含任何墙钟断言。
highlights.en: The finding is that no product code needed changing, consistent with the wasm core's zero-allocation contract; the gate guards regressions and makes no wall-clock assertion.
